description: Link a project directory to a site by writing .coolftp.json. Do this once so later deploys need no site argument.

build.description: Command to run before each deploy, e.g. "npm run build"

cwd.description: Project directory. Defaults to the COOLFTP_PROJECT setting, else the MCP server working directory.

keepBackups.description: Deploys whose previous versions stay on the server for undo (default 5, 0 disables)

remoteRoot.description: Remote directory for this project, if different from the site root

site.description: Site name to deploy this project to

url.description: Public URL that remote directory is served at, e.g. https://example.com. Enables post-deploy verification with correct URLs.

name: coolftp_init
